capabilities: Injects a filter button into every graph view
Auto-discovers subfolders of a configurable root folder as menu entries
Applies graph search queries for Curated reset and All projects entries
Shows the active filter name and per-entry lucide icons
Caches the project list and updates it on file create, delete, or rename
extras: Privacy note: reads only vault file paths, never file contents, no network requests. Zero runtime dependencies; works on desktop and mobile.
intentEvidence: The plugin injects one compact filter button into every graph view.
problem: Filtering the graph view to a project folder requires typing path: search queries by hand each time.
summary: Adds one-click filter buttons to the Obsidian graph view that set path: queries for each project subfolder.
